headline: Home prices refreshed for all 23 places; Wilton Manors and Guerneville values corrected against Zillow.
Blue Ridge Pride expanded its Asheville festival to two days.
D.C. Council gave final approval to the LGBTQ Community Grant Amendment Act of 2026 within the FY 2027 budget.
Colorado HB26-1322 signed: lets people harmed by conversion therapy sue licensed practitioners.
Phoenix Pride filed for Chapter 11 reorganization.
South Carolina H.4756, the Student Physical Privacy Act, signed (Act 152 of 2026).
Metro Weekly reported that a Florida law will end public funding for Key West Pride events.
Pennsylvania House passed HB 2103 (101-100) to add sexual orientation and gender identity to the Human Relations Act; pending in the Senate.
Florida SB 1134 signed: bars counties and municipalities from funding DEI programs, effective 2027-01-01.
Tennessee HB 754 / SB 676 passed both chambers (Public Chapter 932).
Delaware Executive Order 20 expanded the state LGBTQ+ Commission to fifteen members.
New Mexico SB 40 (Driver Privacy and Safety Act) signed.
Tucson Pride cancelled its 2026 festival and dissolved its board.
